—EXTRATERRESTRIAL SIGHTING: Testimony —

Is: And it is from the wart-like leivas, 68 years old, from idephe,
in the Balneário dos Prazeres (Laranjal), in Pelotas, Rio Grande do Sul,
she told us the following rare event she witnessed.

It would have been approximately 10:00 AM, on July 27, 1973. She was alone at home,
since the gas company had fallen behind on their work that day.

Maria, a bit frightened, heard strange noises inside her house,
